Firm.title: Firm
Firm.description: Represents a firm using the logistics application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Firm entity.

firstName.description: First name of the firm's contact person.

lastName.description: Last name of the firm's contact person.

city.description: City where the firm is located.

district.description: District where the firm is located.

profilePicture.description: URL or path to the firm's profile picture.

Load.title: Load
Load.description: Represents a load that a firm wants to transport.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Load entity.

firmId.description: Reference to the Firm that posted the load.

loadType.description: The type or category of the load (e.g., 'Palletized Goods').

tonnage.description: The weight of the load in tons.

originCity.description: City where the load pickup is located.

originDistrict.description: District/area where the load pickup is located.

destinationCity.description: City where the load needs to be transported.

requiredVehicleType.description: Type of vehicle required for the load.

notes.description: Additional notes or instructions for the load.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the load was created.

Driver.title: Driver
Driver.description: Represents a driver who can transport loads.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Driver entity.

vehicleType.description: Type of vehicle the driver has.

vehiclePlate.description: License plate of the driver's vehicle.

profilePicture.description: URL or path to the driver's vehicle profile picture.

currentCity.description: The city the driver is currently in.

isAvailable.description: Whether the driver's vehicle is empty (true) or full (false).

lastLocationUpdate.description: The timestamp of the last location update.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Represents an administrator user who manages the application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Admin entity.

definition.description: Stores load information for each firm. The firmId path parameter ensures only the firm can access its own loads. Denormalizes firmId to allow atomic creation.

params.name: firmId
params.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the firm.

params.name: loadId
params.description: The unique ID of the load.

definition.description: Stores driver data, owned by the user with the corresponding driverId. Uses path-based ownership for simple authorization.

params.name: driverId

params.name: uid
params.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the admin user.

firestore.reasoning:
This design prioritizes security and scalability for the Lojistik Merkezi application. It leverages path-based ownership for user-related data (Firms and Drivers) and a dedicated collection for Admin user management. This approach ensures authorization independence and simplifies security rules. Since firms and drivers should not see each other's data, there is no need to have collaborative data models.

Authorization Independence: The structure is designed to avoid `get()` calls in security rules. Firm and Driver data are stored under their respective user IDs, enabling simple path-based authorization. This eliminates the need to fetch parent document data to authorize access to child documents.

QAPs Support:

*   Secure List Operations: The segregation of Firm and Driver data into separate user-specific collections allows for secure list operations. Rules can easily restrict access to only the data owned by the authenticated user.
*   Admin Roles: The `/roles_admin/{uid}` collection enables secure validation of admin privileges using existence checks, ensuring only authorized users can perform administrative tasks.

Other Considerations:
*   This structure allows easy extension to add new features in the future.
*   Consider adding timestamp fields (`createdAt`, `updatedAt`) to each document for auditing and data management purposes.
